address: via Capo di Fiume 4, Paestum, 84047, Italy
bio: This restaurant lies within the Capodifiume estate, a microcosm that is home to the source of the Trabe river (hence the restaurant name) and a hydroelectric power station which supplies the estate with its energy and which guests can visit with the friendly restaurant staff on a short but interesting tour before dinner. A welcome aperitif and canapés are served in the wine cellar, after which guests move to the elegant dining room – a beautiful setting which also takes into account respect for the environment, with various sustainable practices adopted by the restaurant.
